board: MQ-131 ozone gas sensor module, common blue 4-pin board with LM393 comparator (header VCC, GND, DO, AO) carrying the Winsen MQ131 high-concentration sensor
reason: The first check run passed on ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator (AO voltage slider plus an active-low DO toggle) and the circuit board. AO is modelled as the datasheet's VRL, and the driver uses Rs = (Vc/VRL - 1) x RL with Rs/R0 calibration. The Winsen MQ131-H manual says ozone raises Rs, so AO falls with ozone (the opposite of most shop pages), and the docs say so.
